# kit { #gambeta.kit }

`kit`

Project configuration: paths, season range, and modelling thresholds.

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [ACTIVE_LEAGUES](#gambeta.kit.ACTIVE_LEAGUES) | Leagues with data collected: the full Big 5. |
| [CONTINENTAL_LEAGUES](#gambeta.kit.CONTINENTAL_LEAGUES) | Club competitions above the domestic league. |
| [REFERENCE_LEAGUE](#gambeta.kit.REFERENCE_LEAGUE) | League pinned at zero when solving for league-strength offsets. |
| [SEASONS](#gambeta.kit.SEASONS) | Seasons 2000-01 ("0001") through 2024-25 ("2425"). |
| [STAT_TYPES](#gambeta.kit.STAT_TYPES) | Every season-level table FBref exposes for a single league. |
| [TOURNAMENT_LEAGUES](#gambeta.kit.TOURNAMENT_LEAGUES) | International tournaments. |

## Classes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [Config](#gambeta.kit.Config) | Immutable project configuration. |

### Config { #gambeta.kit.Config }

```python
kit.Config(
    root,
    raw,
    clean,
    derive,
    sample,
    league=REFERENCE_LEAGUE,
    leagues=ACTIVE_LEAGUES,
    continental=CONTINENTAL_LEAGUES,
    tournaments=TOURNAMENT_LEAGUES,
    seasons=SEASONS,
    min_minutes=900,
    min_seasons=3,
    gate_percentile=40.0,
    seed=20260810,
)
```

Immutable project configuration.

#### Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name        | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
|-------------|--------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| root        | Path   | Repository root. All other paths derive from it.                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| min_minutes | int    | Minimum minutes in a season for a player-season to enter a rating.                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| min_seasons | int    | Minimum seasons in a player's peak window for them to be ranked at all. A one-season "best five consecutive seasons" is not a peak-five, and a single observation yields a zero-width interval that reads as certainty when it is the least certain estimate on the page. |
| seed        | int    | Global random seed for every stochastic routine.                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |

## Functions

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [load](#gambeta.kit.load) | Build a :class:`Config` rooted at ``root`` (default: repository root). |

### load { #gambeta.kit.load }

```python
kit.load(root=None)
```

Build a :class:`Config` rooted at ``root`` (default: repository root).
